description.value: Arrowleaf Cellars is an estate winery in Lake Country (Winfield) in the heart of the Okanagan, named after the arrowleaf wildflower native to its vineyards. The property features a tasting room, a picnic and patio area, and rotating food truck days, making it a multi-sensory stop on BC's wine route. Touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan's Camp Road corridor would find it a scenic and well-established destination for local wine and seasonal bites.
